title: the assembly (7.5 - 8.9 ms of the 18.5 - 21 ms chain) has a hot spot whose removal saves at least 1.0 ms per frame with identical graphs

a.recipe: step 0: cProfile / stage timers of PI.assemble (fast=2) on 200 cached frames of fast_recall; step 1 (only if a stage above 15 % exists): the change of that stage in a copy of the code under temp/loop21, interleaved A/B timing and the identity check on all 873 graphs

c.recipe: the unchanged assemble() at the registry settings

rule.note: KEEP (candidate for a code change with ar-reviewer pass) if the changed assembly gives identical graphs on 873 of 873 frames AND is at least 1.0 ms per frame faster in interleaved A/B on 5 repetitions (median of repetition medians, same process, one thread); the machine is loaded (other chat's lane), so the number is RELATIVE and provisional until an idle window repeats it; CUT if no stage above 15 % of the assembly exists after step 0 or the identity check fails

kill: step 0 finds no stage above 15 % of the assembly time (nothing to optimise); identity failure
